description: The data of an issue event.

action.description: What changed: create, update, or remove.

id.description: The Linear id of the issue.

identifier.description: The short name of the issue, for example ENG-42.

url.description: The link to the issue in Linear.

state.description: The workflow state of the issue, for example Todo or Done.

key.description: The team key, for example ENG. It is also the event room.
